target: Next-year upper-floor share among unambiguous floor-known new primary permits
unit: gu x source service x opening year
selection: prior 3 years known >=60 and known/all >=0.8; past only; test n>0 required to measure share, report exclusions
models: previous 3 years smoothed toward city service proportion, strength 30
features: past 1/2/3-year proportions, previous3 count and coverage, city service and gu prior3 proportion, gu/service onehot; training-only imputation/scaling
evaluation: equal-cell MAE percentage points primary, known-count weighted MAE, aggregated record Brier, yearly, service-level; paired gu/service cluster bootstrap 2000 for model minus 3y baseline
decision: exploratory; do not adopt unless both MAEs improve across all six years and paired primary interval below zero; compare all baselines, do not tune on evaluation
caveats: 2025 aggregate already seen, not untouched test
